<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_VacationRequest" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/vacation-request">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_VacationRequest" name="Vacations Request" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_VacationRequest">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Employee" name="Employee">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_SubmitRequest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SubmitRequest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RegisterRequest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReviewRejection</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_RequestRejected</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Supervisor" name="Immediate Supervisor">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveRequest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ApproveOrRejectRequest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RequestApproved</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReturnRejectedRequest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NotifyHumanResources</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_HumanResources" name="Human Resources Representative">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CompleteManagementProcedures</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_VacationApproved</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_SubmitRequest" name="Vacation request submitted">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SubmitToRegister</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SubmitRequest" name="Submit vacation request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_StartToSubmit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SubmitToRegister</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_RegisterRequest" name="Register vacation request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SubmitToRegister</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RegisterToReceive</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ReceiveRequest" name="Receive vacation request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RegisterToReceive</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReceiveToDecide</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ApproveOrRejectRequest" name="Approve or reject vacation request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReceiveToDecide</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DecideToGateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RequestApproved" name="Request approved?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DecideToGateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ApprovedToNotify</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RejectedToReturn</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReturnRejectedRequest" name="Return application with rejection">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RejectedToReturn</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReturnToReview</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ReviewRejection" name="Review rejection reasons">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReturnToReview</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReviewToEndRejected</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_RequestRejected" name="Request rejected">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReviewToEndRejected</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyHumanResources" name="Generate notification to Human Resources">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ApprovedToNotify</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotifyToComplete</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CompleteManagementProcedures" name="Complete vacation management procedures">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotifyToComplete</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CompleteToEndApproved</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_VacationApproved" name="Vacation request processed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CompleteToEndApproved</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToSubmit" sourceRef="StartEvent_SubmitRequest" targetRef="Task_SubmitRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SubmitToRegister" sourceRef="Task_SubmitRequest" targetRef="Task_RegisterRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RegisterToReceive" sourceRef="Task_RegisterRequest" targetRef="Task_ReceiveRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveToDecide" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveRequest" targetRef="Task_ApproveOrRejectRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DecideToGateway" sourceRef="Task_ApproveOrRejectRequest" targetRef="Gateway_RequestApproved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ApprovedToNotify" name="Approved" sourceRef="Gateway_RequestApproved" targetRef="Task_NotifyHumanResources">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">${approved == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RejectedToReturn" name="Rejected" sourceRef="Gateway_RequestApproved" targetRef="Task_ReturnRejectedRequest">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">${approved == false}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReturnToReview" sourceRef="Task_ReturnRejectedRequest" targetRef="Task_ReviewRejection"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReviewToEndRejected" sourceRef="Task_ReviewRejection" targetRef="EndEvent_RequestRejected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotifyToComplete" sourceRef="Task_NotifyHumanResources" targetRef="Task_CompleteManagementProcedures"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CompleteToEndApproved" sourceRef="Task_CompleteManagementProcedures" targetRef="EndEvent_VacationApproved"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ReceiveRequest" name="Receive vacation request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_StartToReceive</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReceiveToDecide</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ApproveOrRejectRequest" name="Approve or reject vacation request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReceiveToDecide</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DecideToGateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RequestApproved" name="Request approved?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DecideToGateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ApprovedToNotify</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RejectedToReturn</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyHumanResources" name="Generate notification to Human Resources">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ApprovedToNotify</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotifyToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReturnRejectedRequest" name="Return application with rejection">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RejectedToReturn</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReturnToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NotificationGenerated" name="Notification generated">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotifyToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_RejectionReturned" name="Rejection returned">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReturnToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToReceive" sourceRef="StartEvent_ReceiveRequest" targetRef="Task_ReceiveRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveToDecide" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveRequest" targetRef="Task_ApproveOrRejectRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DecideToGateway" sourceRef="Task_ApproveOrRejectRequest" targetRef="Gateway_RequestApproved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ApprovedToNotify" name="Approved" sourceRef="Gateway_RequestApproved" targetRef="Task_NotifyHumanResources">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${approved == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RejectedToReturn" name="Rejected" sourceRef="Gateway_RequestApproved" targetRef="Task_ReturnRejectedRequest">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${approved == false}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotifyToEnd" sourceRef="Task_NotifyHumanResources" targetRef="EndEvent_NotificationGenerated"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReturnToEnd" sourceRef="Task_ReturnRejectedRequest" targetRef="EndEvent_RejectionReturned"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_HumanResources" name="Human Resources Representative" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_NotificationReceived" name="Approval notification available">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_StartToComplete</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CompleteManagementProcedures" name="Complete vacation management procedures">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_StartToComplete</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CompleteToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ProceduresCompleted" name="Management procedures completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CompleteToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToComplete" sourceRef="StartEvent_NotificationReceived" targetRef="Task_CompleteManagementProcedures"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CompleteToEnd" sourceRef="Task_CompleteManagementProcedures" targetRef="EndEvent_ProceduresCompleted"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

rules.instruction: Several unconditional outgoing flows from one activity can all proceed. Use a gateway when the description requires a decision or synchronization.
rules.situation: the description states a single follow-up step after a task (for example a reviewing or acting step) and names no decision, alternative, or parallel branch after it

rules.instruction: When the description has a step of one role whose result is passed to a different role, and the receiving role then performs its own described step as a task in its own pool (for example, a role that is asked to act on information or an item another role has sent): Model the receiving step as a task in the receiving role's pool and draw a message flow from the sending step in the sender's pool to that receiving task, with the arrow pointing from sender to receiver. Do not replace this flow with one that ends at a catch event when the receiver's described step is a performed task, and do not reverse the arrow direction.
rules.situation: the description states that a step is handed from one role to another, either by forwarding an item to a person, by returning an item to a person on a branch, or by sending a notification to a role, and the receiving role must then carry out a further described action

rules.instruction: When the description states that a submitted item is first registered or recorded by the system or a party, and only afterwards is received by a different participant who must decide on it: Model the registration or recording as its own task placed after the submission start and before the receiving participant's step. Model the receiving participant's receipt as a separate task in that participant's lane, placed before the decision task. Do not merge registration, receipt and decision into one task, and do not drop the registration step.
rules.situation: the description states that a submitted item is first registered or recorded by the system or a party, and only afterwards is received by a different participant who must decide on it

rules.instruction: When the description states, in its own sentence after an earlier step, that a role receives, returns, or completes the item that step produced, so that the same item passes to a different role or back to an earlier participant: Model each such stated action as its own task placed on the sequence flow after the step that produced the item, in the lane or pool of the role that performs it. Label the task with the action wording the description gives (for example, 'receive', 'return', or 'complete' plus the object), not a generic or alternative label. Do not merge this action into the preceding task, and do not replace it with an element of another type.
rules.situation: the description states, in its own sentence after an earlier step, that a role receives, returns, or completes the item that step produced, so that the same item passes to a different role or back to an earlier participant

rules.instruction: When the description states an action performed on an item by no named system or role, using passive wording such as 'is registered' or 'is returned to' a party, and does not say that software performs it: Model that action as a plain task (bpmn:task) labeled with the described action or outcome. Reserve bpmn:serviceTask for steps the description says an automated system performs, and bpmn:userTask for steps it says a named person performs. Do not assign a service or user subtype from the verb alone.
rules.situation: the description states an action performed on an item by no named system or role, using passive wording such as 'is registered' or 'is returned to' a party, and does not say that software performs it
